_doc: Component library (docs/PIPELINE.md Library lane). One entry per reusable component. Edit by hand or via tools/catalog.py; previews via tools/catalog_preview.py; gallery: library/CATALOG.md. 'internal' = helper functions reviewed in a harvest and deliberately not catalogued (they are used through catalogued components).

statuses.approved: owner-approved or used in a published/final video
